Nilakantha Palace:
Nilkantha is a charming spot named after an old shiva shrine which once exited here. The structure ,built of red stone, is a pleasure-house constructed by a governor of the mugal emporer Akbar in the sixteenth century, as recorded in an inscription on the site. This building has no architectural pretensions but its style is typical of the period of Akbar.

ImageDescription.value: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple, Bhinmal Located in the historic town of Bhinmal, in Rajasthan’s Jalore district, the Neelkanth Mahadev Temple is a divine and grand Shiva temple. It is not only a center for spiritual practice but also a prominent religious tourist destination. Dedicated to Lord Shiva in his Neelkanth form, the temple offers a unique blend of devotion, faith, and inner peace for its devotees. 🛕 Temple Highlights Majestic spire and intricately carved stone architecture Clean and peaceful surroundings, ideal for meditation and worship Daily evening Aarti offers a spiritually uplifting experience for visitors 🎉 Major Festivals and Events Pran Pratishtha Festival: Held in January (17–27), featuring Kalash Yatra, Ram Katha, Yajna, and idol consecration rituals The event was graced by Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami 🏨 Nearby Facilities Ample parking space near the temple Proper arrangements for prasad distribution, drinking water, and cleanliness Shops outside the temple offer easy access to puja materials Nearby guesthouses and hotels are available at affordable rates 📸 Tourist Attractions Stunning sunset views from the temple premises The majestic Shiva flagpole (Dhwaja Stambh) at the entrance is a striking sight The nearby Amrit Kund (sacred water reservoir) holds deep religious significance 🧾 Conclusion Neelkanth Mahadev Temple is not just a center for Shiva devotion, but also a place of serenity, cultural festivities, and spiritual power. If you’re planning a visit to Bhinmal, make this temple a top priority—it will leave you with a profound and peaceful experience.
